name: Settlement statement
what: The closing statement showing every charge and credit to buyer and seller and where the money goes.

fields.label: Settlement agent
fields.definition: The title company or escrow agent named as settlement agent, and the escrow officer handling the file.

fields.label: Files the sale report
fields.definition: The party the closing file names as responsible for filing the information return that reports the sale.

fields.label: Version
fields.definition: Estimated, draft or final, with the date and time printed on it; compare each version line by line with the one before.

fields.label: Settlement date
fields.definition: The closing date, with the disbursement date noted if funds go out on a different day.

fields.label: Purchase price
fields.definition: The contract price charged to the buyer and credited to the seller.

fields.label: Earnest money credit
fields.definition: Deposits credited to the buyer, which should match the escrow agent's receipts.

fields.label: Prorations
fields.definition: Each item split at closing, such as property taxes, collected rents and operating expenses, with the period, the daily or monthly amount and which side is credited.

fields.label: Tenant deposits and prepaid rent
fields.definition: Tenant security deposits and prepaid rents credited to the buyer; match them to the rent roll and the estoppels.

fields.label: New loan
fields.definition: The loan proceeds funded for the buyer, with the lender fees, interest and reserves withheld from them listed separately.

fields.label: Payoffs
fields.definition: Each existing lien paid at closing, with payee and amount; match each one to its payoff letter.

fields.label: Title and escrow charges
fields.definition: Title premiums, endorsements, escrow fees, tax certificates and recording charges, each with who pays it.

fields.label: Commissions
fields.definition: Each brokerage commission with its payee and amount.

fields.label: Other charges
fields.definition: Every other charge, such as survey, legal, inspection or courier fees, each with payee, amount and which side pays.

fields.label: Buyer's cash to close
fields.definition: The amount the buyer must deliver after all charges and credits; reconcile it to the cent before any wire.

fields.label: Seller's net proceeds
fields.definition: What the seller receives after all charges, credits and payoffs.
